description: This line plot illustrates how three metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—vary with Question Popularity, ranging from 5 to 25 on the x-axis, which is labeled “Question Popularity” and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.55 to 1.00 and also uses a linear scale. The blue line with circle markers represents Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.61 at Question Popularity 5, rising to a peak of 0.81 at 11, dipping to 0.71 at 14, and then increasing steadily to 0.88 at 25. The green line with triangle markers represents Confidence, beginning at approximately 0.93 at 5, remaining relatively stable around 0.95–0.97 until 15, and then slightly increasing to 0.98 at 25. The red line with square markers represents Alignment, starting at approximately 0.69 at 5, rising to 0.85 at 11, dipping to 0.78 at 14, and then increasing to 0.90 at 25.
